objective: Investigate limitations in joint modeling of multi-behavior user histories and multi-field features; implement and test at least one mechanism-distinct candidate when evidence and budget permit. Current research question: 在相同可见历史下，事件、行为组或字段组的表示粒度怎样影响信息保留和计算成本？
success_policy: Report model performance, mechanism evidence, and differences from prior work separately. An unsupported or unsuccessful new mechanism is a valid research outcome when faithfully documented; replication and tuning alone are not a new contribution.

dataset.name: Taobao display advertising click-through-rate dataset
dataset.acquisition_status: four raw tables verified by host; private physical paths not exported

agent_binding.delivery: resolve the task reference on demand; materialize only the current task, experiment and evidence in temporary working context
agent_binding.recovery: Reuse accepted outputs only with matching input, protocol and source hashes; retain unfinished-call and failed-experiment costs.

fixed_agent_boundary_audit.scope: all fixed agent artifacts, not transient task/tool responses
fixed_agent_boundary_audit.limitation: Structural and lexical boundary checks do not prove freedom from every possible semantic bias.

rules: Find nearest methods before asserting novelty
A retrieved citation verifies provenance, not scientific truth

industry.scientific_status: external reports; no local reproduction or automatic transfer claim
industry.task_mismatch: source pCVR and multi-domain fields versus target CTR and category/brand/action/time histories
industry.delivery: Five shared source cards available on demand through tools.py search; evidence is external only.

personal.future_updates: Human edits create new read-only versions. New versions enter the next working context; conflicts generate agent-memory records and revision suggestions, never edits to the human source.

agent.storage: append-only experiment receipts and evidence-linked observations, explanations, counterexamples and superseding revisions
agent.withheld_results: closed assessment archive, never open research memory for a reused holdout
agent.delivery: Current study receipts and source-linked provisional interpretations, when supplied. Other arms are inaccessible.

research_flow.entry: audit actual fields, causal availability, label prevalence, compute, existing code and complete-unit experiment cost
baseline_requirements: a history reference with simple pooling
a credible target-aware history reference adapted to the actual available fields
reference_candidates_not_prescribed: embedding MLP or DCN-style static reference
DMR-inspired relevance modeling with explicitly documented field substitutions
research_flow.question_selection: Choose a concrete observed limitation after baseline and slice diagnostics. Do not preselect a winning mechanism from the industry cards.
research_flow.nearest_work_check: Record inherited components, mechanism difference, source version/locator and novelty uncertainty before execution.
attribution: lineage-aware comparison of positive, null and failed trajectories
repetitions when a direction remains consequential
research_flow.continuation: A direction may continue across multiple rounds when evidence justifies another diagnostic or implementation change; one failed implementation is not a mechanism refutation.
research_flow.screening: Optional fixed user-hash subsets and internal temporal folds are screening-only. Preserve prevalence and time boundaries; final candidates and controls use the frozen full protocol. Never compare a subset result to a full-data result as if matched.

cost_views: matched training recipe/data passes for mechanism isolation
measured equal-compute or quality-cost frontier for efficiency
analysis.slice_rules: Define bins using training data or pre-experiment rules, report sample/positive/negative counts; mark insufficient slices, and distinguish exploratory from predeclared confirmatory findings.
analysis.uncertainty: Paired seeds and paired user-cluster bootstrap where feasible; repeated exposures from a user are not independent samples. Report intervals and seed variation without claiming significance from one run.

agent_editable: candidate model and registered training configuration
host_owned: causal feature construction and split policy
implementation_boundary.candidate_interface: Defined by the task adapter at freeze time; must return prediction logits/probabilities with fixed sample identity and information boundary.
implementation_boundary.protocol_change: Requires a new version and rerun of affected references before any new comparison; no silent changes during search.

final_assessment.repetitions: Target three paired seeds for the final candidate and closest controls when budget permits; record omitted repetitions and retain single-seed conclusions as preliminary.
final_assessment.test: Unavailable in this operational rerun; evaluate validation repetitions only. Closed assessment outputs are not authorized research inputs.
final_assessment.failure: Retain failed assessment receipts; unknown execution state does not authorize automatic duplicate testing.

deliverables: best supported model code/configuration and executable reproduction commands
boundaries, unresolved questions and next hypotheses

research_topic.question: 在相同可见历史下，事件、行为组或字段组的表示粒度怎样影响信息保留和计算成本？
